what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cuba in Peru: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7933 Cuban asylum seekers in Peru, 2.8% of all asylum seekers from Cuba.
Refugees from Cuba, a separate group, live mostly in Mexico, the United States and Costa Rica.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Cuba, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Peru.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Peru only.
